line: Organisational psychology and supply chain management is an unusual pairing on a coach's bio, and it says you read organisations as whole systems rather than just people problems.
notes: Reversed from rank 1 (LinkedIn ICF badge post) to rank 2 (About page) on coordinator review: the badge post is templated activity-feed content and the sentence following the quote is ICF boilerplate, not hers, so remarking on it reads as feed-surveillance rather than as evidence we read her page.
